Shares are spherical-area weighted (cos latitude) over pixels whose centre lies in the GHS-UCDB polygon. tree/green/built shares use land (valid minus class 80 water) as denominator; water_share uses all valid pixels.
Global overall accuracy of v200 is 76.7+-0.5% (PVR V2.0); built-up user's accuracy 65.9%, producer's 73.2%.
